summary: Retest of the iteration_29 HIGH proxy crash. Fixed and verified through the public URL. These now return 400: /api/dashboard/%FF, %C0%AF, %E0%A4%A, a bare %, assets/%FF.js and %FF?x=1. A burst of 10 malformed requests does the same. The fleet-preview-proxy pid stayed 6988 for the whole run. Missing /api/dashboard/assets/missing.{js,css,map,png,svg,ico,json} return 404, not index.html. SPA deep links (/stops, /drivers/3, /api/dashboard, ?x=1, /assets) return index.html with 200. All index.html js/css assets load with the correct content-type. Eight path traversal variants (%2e%2e, %2f, %5c, %00, sibling directory, package.json) leak nothing. /api/dashboardfoo now goes to the API instead of the dashboard. pytest: test_round29_preview_proxy.py 17/17 and the new test_round30_proxy_hardening.py 30/30, 47/47 total. Live sockets through the proxy work: the dashboard note reached the driver and the reply reached the dashboard in websocket, polling and default (upgraded to websocket) modes. Driver app Trip History for james shows 'Odometer 48376 → 48410', '34 miles' and a '188 mi' total, with no '.0' anywhere. Minor leftover: the Home screen still shows '188.0 mi · last 5 trips' and '34.0' on the recent-trip cards.

ui_bugs.issue: Home still formats mileage with toFixed(1): '188.0 mi · last 5 trips' and '34.0' on the recent-trip cards. This does not match Trip History ('188 mi', '34'). Reference: /app/driver-app/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx:171 and :206

action_items: Optional cosmetic: reuse the TripHistoryScreen num() helper in HomeScreen.tsx lines 171 and 206 so Home shows '188 mi' and '34' instead of '188.0' and '34.0'.
critical_code_review_comments: preview-proxy.js handles bad input safely: URIError returns 400, the path.sep containment check works, missing assets with extensions return 404, and the read stream has an error handler. Minor: the res socket has no 'error' listener, but Node's http server already handles client resets, so nothing needs to change.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the requested checks; 1 low-priority cosmetic issue on the Home screen

seed_data_creation: None kept. The socket test created TEST_ notes 7, 8 and 9, which were deleted by id. Seeded note 2 is untouched (read_at, reply and replied_at all null). James still has 6 trips. auth_rate_limits was cleared (4 rows).
